resources.string: UTF-8 TXT / TSV: phrase, TAB, space-separated pinyin, optional TAB and weight. Example: 双卡双待 [TAB] shuang ka shuang dai. Merges existing words; maximum 4 MiB and 50,000 entries. Proprietary binary dictionaries need conversion to this format.
